parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Plot the five-number summary for B accurately on the common scale. [B1]
Guidance: Plot all five values for B accurately in standard box-plot form using the stated scale, and label it B; judge values at the middle of each vertical line.
Plot the five-number summary for A accurately on the same scale. [B1 FT]
Guidance: Follow through part (a): plot all five values for A accurately in standard box-plot form using the stated scale, and label it A.
Complete both standard box plots, with a linear diameter scale in cm. [B1]
Guidance: For both plots, whiskers must not pass through boxes or meet box corners. Use one linear scale with at least three stated values, covering at least $0.34$ to $0.38$, labelled as diameter in cm. If both plots are attempted but unlabelled, special-case B1 is available for at least one fully correct five-value plot.
Total: 3
